cues.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看新一期《LGR 奇特硬件》，
cues.en: Greetings, and welcome to another episode of LGR Oddware,

cues.zh: 今天我们来看看一些奇特、被遗忘、已经过时的硬件和软件，
cues.en: where we're taking a look at hardware and software that is odd, forgotten, and obsolete,

cues.zh: 今天的主角是 Danmere Backer：
cues.en: and today, it is the Danmere Backer:

cues.zh: 一套用于 PC 硬盘备份的磁带系统。
cues.en: The PC hard disk tape backup system.

cues.zh: 没错，你可以把数据备份到 VHS 录像带上，
cues.en: Yeah, that's right, you can back up your data to VHS video tape

cues.zh: 只要在当年的 386 及以上 PC 上装上这块 ISA 卡就行。
cues.en: by use of this ISA card that works on 386 and up PCs

cues.zh: 真的。
cues.en: of the time period. Seriously.

cues.zh: 不过，在计算机领域，用磁带备份数据倒算不上多么*稀奇*。
cues.en: Although backing up computer data to tape is not the most *unusual* thing in the computing world.

cues.zh: 复古电脑用盒式磁带备份数据，或者读取游戏和程序，
cues.en: Uh, retro computers had cassete tapes that they backed up to or read games and programs from,

cues.zh: 后来也有数据磁带，用来备份和存储海量数据。
cues.en: and then you still have data cartridge tapes that are used for backup solutions and store tons of tons of data.

cues.zh: 但备份到 VHS 录像带，这我还真是头一回听说。
cues.en: But backing up to VHS, now *that* is a new one on me.

cues.zh: 来看看这东西到底怎么样。
cues.en: So let's see what we got here.

cues.zh: 该近距离认识一下 Danmere Backer 了，
cues.en: Time to get up close and personal with the Danmere Backer,

cues.zh: 这个型号也叫 Backer16 硬盘磁带备份系统。
cues.en: with this model also being known as the Backer16 hard disk tape backup system.

cues.zh: 它由英国的 Danmere Limited 在 1996 年初左右推出，售价 60 美元。
cues.en: It was sold right around the start of 1996 by Danmere Limited of England for $60 US.

cues.zh: 它只用单色复合视频信号来工作，支持 PAL 或 NTSC 格式。
cues.en: And this uses monochrome composite video signals *only* to do its thing either in PAL or NTSC format.

cues.zh: 没错，这里完全没有音频，只用视频信号。
cues.en: Yeah, there's no audio here whatsoever. It only uses the video signal.

cues.zh: 盒子上说它最多能存 1.5 GB，
cues.en: According to the box, it can store up 1½ gigs,

cues.zh: 但据我所知，实际容量从 750 MB 到 3 GB 不等，
cues.en: but from what I've read, it actually ranges from 750 megs to 3 gigabytes,

cues.zh: 具体取决于设置、压缩选项以及所用的磁带类型。
cues.en: depending on your settings, compression options, and what kind of tape that you use.

cues.zh: 升级型号一直卖到 20 世纪 90 年代末，其中一款外观更简洁一些。
cues.en: Updated models were available through the late 1990s, including one that was a little sleeker-looking.

cues.zh: 这是一款通过并口连接的外置设备，功能也大同小异，
cues.en: This was an external that connected via parallel and did much the same thing,

cues.zh: 但容量最高可达 4 GB，和后来推出的扩展卡版本 Backer32 一样。
cues.en: but could store up to 4 gigabytes, same as the later card version, the Backer32.

cues.zh: 你可能会好奇，“这东西究竟是做给谁用的？”其实……就是预算有限的人。
cues.en: Now you might be wondering, "Who was this made for?" Well... anyone on a budget, really.

cues.zh: Backer 最大的卖点就是价格和便利性。
cues.en: The Backer's big appeal was price and convenience.

cues.zh: 因为当时一盘 VHS 录像带只要 2 美元左右，
cues.en: Since a VHS tape was around $2 at the time,

cues.zh: 远比同等容量的专用磁带便宜得多，后者可能要 15 到 30 美元。
cues.en: a lot less than the $15 or $30 a tape cartridge of a similar capacity might cost.

cues.zh: 而且你直接用家里的录像机就行，不用花大钱买更专业的设备。
cues.en: And of course, you just used your VCR instead of shelling out for anything more specialized.

cues.zh: 它的传输速度据称可达每分钟 9 MB，
cues.en: It also boasted a 9 megabyte per minute transfer speed,

cues.zh: 也就是每秒 150 KB 左右，
cues.en: or around a 150k per second,

cues.zh: 和当时其他 VHS 备份系统差不多。
cues.en: similar to other VHS backup systems of the time.

cues.zh: 没错，这也意味着 Backer 并不是当时家用电脑唯一的 VHS 备份系统。
cues.en: And yeah, that means that the Backer was not the only VHS backup system for home computers.

cues.zh: 还有一款名字起得很贴切的设备，叫 Commodore Amiga 视频备份系统，
cues.en: There was the aptly-named Video Backup System for the Commodore Amiga,

cues.zh: 其中最值得一提的，或许是 ArVid 1000 系列，
cues.en: and perhaps most notably was the ArVid 1000 series,

cues.zh: 它和 Backer 更相似，因为都是面向 PC 的 ISA 卡。
cues.en: which was more similar to the Backer, being that these were ISA cards for the PC.

cues.zh: 这些设备于 1992 年在俄罗斯泽列诺格勒开始生产，一直持续到 90 年代中期。
cues.en: And they were made in Zelenograd, Russia in 1992 through the mid '90s.

cues.zh: 你猜怎么着：甚至有个叫 Transcom 的团体，在 VHS 录像带上发行盗版软件合集，
cues.en: And get this: There was even a group called Transcom that distributed shady software compilations on VHS,

cues.zh: 这真让我大开眼界。
cues.en: which kind of blows my mind.

cues.zh: 不过，尽管有几项优势，Danmere 的备份系统始终没能真正流行起来，
cues.en: However, even with a few points in their favor, Danmere's Backup system never really caught on,

cues.zh: 所以现在很难找到一台。
cues.en: and as such, it's incredibly hard to find one now.

cues.zh: 但公司放弃 VHS 备份系统后，又经营了一段时间，
cues.en: But the company stuck around for a while after giving up on VHS backup systems,

cues.zh: 并于 2000 年重组为 4TV Limited，
cues.en: reorganizing to become 4TV Limited in the year 2000,

cues.zh: 之后开发电视机顶盒软件等产品，直到公司在 2014 年正式解散。
cues.en: and working on things like TV set-top box software until the company finally dissolved in 2014.
